name: Environmental Trust Fund (New Brunswick)
summary: New Brunswick funding for action-based projects that protect and enhance the natural environment, including water, coastlines, wetlands and climate response, led by non-profits, First Nations, local governments and regional service commissions. The 2027-2028 intake is open with a yearless November 30 deadline.
